stories.title: Govt cuts petrol by Rs1, increases diesel by Rs2 till Nov 23
summary: The federal government on Friday decreased the price of petrol by Rs1 while increasing high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs2 per litre till November 23.

stories.title: Pakistan crowned Men’s Blind Cricket Asia Cup champions
summary: Pakistan were declared winners of the Blind Cricket Asia Cup T20 after persistent rain prevented their final against arch-rivals India from taking place in Dhaka, with match referee awarding the title under the competition's playing conditions.

summary: Turkiye's Oruc Reis seismic research vessel would begin exploration for ​hydrocarbon resources in offshore fields in Pakistan, ‌Turkish Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar said on Friday, adding that drilling was expected to start ​in 2027.

stories.title: Signal restricts screenshots to block AI agents from reading messages
summary: To prevent agents from scanning Signal messages, the service is introducing new settings blocking screenshot access on people's phones and switching those restrictions on by default.

Signal said that developers should have straightforward ways of opting their apps out of such data processing by AI assistants entirely, specifically mentioning screen reading, notifications and other file ⁠system access.

AI systems that scan people's screens can undermine those protections by pulling the ​messages out of Signal's secure environment and into whatever other servers the agent is using, it said in the post.

stories.title: Astronomers observe a huge puffy star merge with smaller companion
summary: Astronomers have observed a large dying star, seven times more massive and 18,000 times brighter than the sun, engulfing a smaller companion in a stellar merger unlike any other ​previously witnessed.
'SET OFF A BOMB' The researchers detected brightening when this occurred in 2018, and the smaller star began to ​spiral inward toward the core of the bigger star over the next seven years.
While the larger of the two stars in this instance was nearing the end of its life, the merger may have produced a rejuvenated star with a new lease on life, the researchers said.

stories.title: Big Pharma, with eye on Anthropic, says AI is shrinking drug discovery timelines
summary: Artificial intelligence has sped up early-stage drug development work at some of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies this year, cutting by as much as half the time it takes to produce new molecules and move them into the clinic, according to their ​top scientists.

Some of the scientists say decades of drug discovery experience and data give them an advantage over AI companies like Anthropic, which is gearing up to be a rival, partner or both, with a $1.5 trillion initial public offering this week.
Other companies, including Novo Nordisk, use ​Anthropic models and Claude Science in their R&D work.

stories.title: UK finds fix for fridge and freezer vulnerability after European hacks
summary: A British cybersecurity operation has fixed a flaw in ​the operating systems of commercial fridges and freezers used ‌by supermarkets, warehouses and restaurants, helping protect them from hacks that hit several European countries in recent weeks.

A wave of cyberattacks knocked out commercial ​fridges and freezers from Sweden to Belgium earlier in ​November, while a similar hack hit France in October, forcing ⁠stores to throw away millions of euros' worth of ​food.

French intelligence and cyber agencies accused Iran's Revolutionary Guards of carrying out the October hack, which targeted 700 commercial sites and caused ​15 fires ​after hackers raised ⁠temperatures in refrigeration systems.

stories.title: Tarar says public opinion should determine creation of new provinces
summary: Information Minister Attaullah Tarar on Friday backed holding a referendum to determine public opinion on the creation of new provinces, saying the proposal should proceed only if people supported it.
The idea of holding one on the creation of new provinces was floated by Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, who argued that it could help establish public opinion on the issue and settle the debate.

Sindh Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah rejected Naqvi’s assessment that the governance system had collapsed and called the proposal outdated, warning that no bloodshed would be allowed over the creation of new provinces.

stories.title: Alia Bhatt says motherhood has reshaped her career priorities, wants more time with daughter
summary: Indian Actor Alia Bhatt has said that while she loves being in the spotlight, spending time with her daughter remains a priority, explaining how motherhood has reshaped her approach to work and professional commitments.

Bhatt acknowledged in her TIME profile that her professional standing had helped her secure accommodating producers, but stressed that fair working hours should become standard across the industry rather than a privilege reserved for established stars.
Bhatt's TIME100 Next India recognition came after more than a decade in the film industry, during which she moved between commercial successes and critically acclaimed performances.

stories.title: Protesters rally in Paris against bill presuming police who used their firearms acted lawfully
summary: Protesters staged a rally in Paris on Thursday as lawmakers debated a bill that would presume police officers acted lawfully when using their firearms.

Dozens of associations and nongovernmental organisations gathered near the French Senate to protest the proposed legislation, which would presume that police officers acted lawfully when using their firearms, shifting the burden of proof in cases involving police shootings.

Among those addressing the demonstrators was Issam El Khalfaoui, of North African descent –whose 19-year-old son Souheil was fatally shot by police in Marseille in 2021 – who told protesters that the legislation could reduce scrutiny of police use of force.

summary: Field Marshal Munir has made several visits to K-P since assuming command of the army in November 2022, including visits to the former tribal districts to review security arrangements and counter-terrorism efforts.
